source_caption:
🎥🎬: By Any Means (2026)

When justice has limits, survival demands another way.

Based on a true story, By Any Means follows a determined man caught in a dangerous struggle where crime, power, and personal survival collide. Forced to confront ruthless opposition and an increasingly violent world, he realizes that achieving his goal may require him to cross lines he never expected to cross.

As pressure builds and the consequences become impossible to escape, every choice brings him closer to a confrontation that could change everything. Blending historical crime, action, and suspense, By Any Means is a gripping story of determination, danger, and doing whatever it takes.

source_details.synopsis: By Any Means is a 2026 American historical crime thriller film directed by Elegance Bratton and written by Sascha Penn. The film stars Yahya Abdul-Mateen II, Mark Wahlberg, Nicole Beharie, Josh Lucas, David Strathairn, and Giancarlo Esposito. A young Black FBI agent teams up with notorious New York City mafia hitman, Greg Scarpa, to investigate the murders of civil rights leaders in Mississippi in 1966. By Any Means premiered on September 1, 2026, at the Paramount Pictures Studios in Los Angeles, and theatrically released in the United States by Paramount Pictures on September 4, 2026. The film received mixed reviews from critics.
